# Vendored: do not edit

A copy of [agent-skills](https://github.com/ghostaff-ai/agent-skills/tree/f60dc96918bfb497ad55fae3cfebb185e4c54821),
commit `f60dc96918bfb497ad55fae3cfebb185e4c54821`.
